records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the three months ended September 30, 2023 were $258,400,000, up $26,660,000 or 11.5% from the three months ended September 30, 2022 net sales of $231,740,000.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were positively impacted by $10,556,000 due to price increases, $9,539,000 of revenue from the montratec acquisition and $1,013,000 of sales volume increases.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Foreign currency translation favorably impacted sales by $5,552,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our principal raw materials and components purchases were approximately $365 million in fiscal 2023 (or 61% of Cost of product sold) and include steel, consisting of rod, wire, bar, structural, and other forms of steel; electric motors; bearings; gear reducers; castings; steel and aluminum enclosures and wire harnesses; electro-mechanical components; and standard variable drives and controls.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used for operating activities was $558,000 for the six months ended September 30, 2023 compared to net cash provided by operating activities of $6,149,000 for the six months ended September 30, 2022.
